title.zh: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
title.en: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks

current_state.zh: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin fell about $400 million in market capitalization over two weeks to roughly $4.02 billion amid large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain, including nearly $200 million from one unidentified address.
